NOT closed on candidate sha256:cf40705b. The repair (T-DG6-FE-Y1) gave the 17 named specs measured file-level budgets, but the finding's own round-1 reproduction also named p4-benefits test 8 and p4-gates-closure test 6 as 30 s timeouts at review load, and FE-Y1's handback lists both as 'Not done'. Re-run of my round-1 reproduction on this candidate (full product runs, --workers=1, production-initialized stack): p4-benefits '8. Auditor read-only; register and benefit page at 390 px and 200 % text' failed with 'Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded' in 3 of 4 full runs (en unset 30.6 s, ar unset 30.1 s, en C.UTF-8 30.9 s; passed in ar C.UTF-8); p4-gates-closure '6. Modular G3 ...' and p3-journeys '2a. prioritization ...' also timed out at 30 s in the full en run and AGAIN when re-run alone at load ~20 (06b: 3 failed, all 30 s timeouts). With a measurement-only --timeout=120000 the three specs pass 36/36 (p4-benefits 8 in 43.3 s, p3-journeys 2a 29.2 s, p4-gates-closure 6 26.0 s), so no product defect is behind them: only the budget is missing. Static scan: 14 product specs budget only some of their tests (e.g. p3-journeys 1 of 18, p4-benefits 1 of 9, p4-gates-closure 2 of 9), so their other tests still run on the default 30 s. Expected (the finding): a journey that needs more than 30 s under review load carries an explicit, measured budget so a gate run is not decided by host load.
